ind. 
__1 this particle is most generally used to report the very words spoken or supposed to be spoken by some one, as represented by quotation marks in English. The speech reported may be (1) a single word used merely to express what the form of the word is, when it is used as it is (शब्दस्वरूपद्योतक); कूजन्तं रामरामेति मधुरं मधुराक्षरम् [[Rāmarakṣā.]] अत एव गवित्याह [[Bh.]]; (2) or a substantive, which must be put in the nominative case when its meaning is to be indicated [Page0382-1] (प्रातिपदिकार्थद्योतक); चयस्त्विषामित्यवधारितं पुरा … कमादमुं नारद इत्यबोधि सः [[Śi. 1]], 3.; अवैमि चैनामनघेति [[
]]; sometimes with acc. कैवर्तमिति यं प्राहुः [[

]]; (3) or a whole sentence when इति is merely used at the end of that sentence; (वाक्यार्थद्योतक); ज्ञास्यसि कियद् भुजो मे रक्षति मौर्वींकिणाङ्क इति [[Śi. 1. 13]]; तयोर्मुनिकुमारयोरन्यतरः कथयति अक्षमालामुपयाचितुमागतोस्मीति [[

.]] 
__2 Besides this general sense इति has the following senses: 
___(a) Cause, as expressed by ‘because’, ‘since’, ‘on the ground that’, in English; वैदेशिकोऽस्मीति पृच्छामि [[U.]]; पुराणमित्येव नःसाधु सर्वम् [[

]], oft. with किम् q. v. 
___(b) Purpose or motive, as expressed by ‘that’, ‘in order that’ शरीरस्य विनाशो मा भूदिति मयेदमुत्क्षिप्य समानीतम् [[

.]] 
___(c) Thus, to mark the conclusion (opp. अथ);

thus or here ends the first Act. 
___(d) It is often used to include under one head a number of separate objects grouped together; पृथिव्यापस्तेजो बायुराकाशं कालो दिगात्मा मन

[[T. S.]] 
___(e) So, thus, in this manner; इत्युक्तबन्तं परिरभ्य दोर्भ्याम् [[

.]] 
___(f) Of this nature or description; गौरश्वः पुरुषो हस्तीति जातिः. 
___(g) As follows, to the following effect; रामाभिधानो हरिरित्युवाच [[

.]] 
___(h) As for, in the capacity of, as regards, showing capacity or relation; पितेति स पूज्यः, अध्यापक

, शीघ्रमिति सुकरं, निभृतमिति चिन्तनीयं भवेत् [[Ś. 3.]] 
___(i) It is often used with the name of an author to form an Avyayibhāva comp. इतिपाणिनि thus according to Pāṇini. 
___(j) Illustration (usually with आदि); इन्दुरिन्दुरिव श्रीमानित्यादौ तदनन्वयः [[Chandr.]]; गौः शुक्लश्चलो डित्थ इत्यादौ [[K.

.]] 
___(k) A quotation or an opinion accepted;

&c.

-Comp. 
-अर्थः sum and substance, meaning in short (often used by commentators). 
-अर्थम् ind. for this purpose, hence. 
-आदि a. having such a thing or things at the beginning, so forth, et caetera (&c.). इत्यादिप्रचुराः पुरातनकथाः सर्बेभ्य एवं श्रुताः [[Udb.]] 
-उक्तम् information, report. 
-कथ a. 
__1 not fit to be believed, untrustworthy. 
__2 wicked, lost. 
(-था) a meaningless or nonsensical talk. 
-कर्तव्य, -करणीय, -कार्य, -कृत्य a. proper or necessary to be done according to certain rules. (कर्तव्यम्, -णीयम्) duty, obligation; श्रूयतामितिकर्तव्यं सर्वानेव ब्रवीमि वः [[

.]] °ता, 
-कार्यता, -कृत्यता any proper or necessary duty, obligation; स मुहूर्तमिव ध्यात्वा विनिश्चित्योतिकृत्यताम् [[

.]] इतिकर्तव्यतामूढः wholly at a loss what to do, embarrassed, perplexed. 
-पाणिनि ind. Thus according to Pāṇini's [Page0382-2] very words. 
-मात्र a. of such extent or quality. 
-वृत्तम् 
__1 occurrence, event. 
__2 a tale, story.

a. [ई-क्तिच्] 
__1 Produced, effected. 
-तिः f. Plague, distress, a calamity of the season. The itis are usually said to be six:-- (1) excessive rain; (2) drought; (3) locusts; (4) rats; (5) parrots; and (6) foreign invasions; अतिवृष्टिरनाव्रष्टिः शलभा मूषकाः शुकाः । प्रत्यासन्नाश्च राजानः षडेता ईतयः स्मृताः ॥ (some read for the second line स्बचक्रं [Page0392-2] परचकं च सप्तैता ईतयः स्मृताः ॥ making the total number seven); आशास्यमीतिविगमप्रभृति प्रजानाम् [[

.]] 
__2 An infectious disease. 
__3 Travelling (in a foreign country), sojourning (प्रवास). 
__4 An affray.

__1 History (legendary or traditional); धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणामुपदेशसमन्वितम् पूर्ववृत्तं कथायुक्तमितिहासं प्रचक्षते; [[Mb.]] cf. also आर्यादिबहुव्याख्यानं देवर्षिचरिताश्रयम् । इतिहासमिति प्रोक्तं भविष्याद्भुतधर्मयुक् ॥
